transcript.answer: Pull request #2823, "Context evals: run from a developer machine, never on a schedule" (author gedaiu, merged 2026-10-19). It deleted `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml`, the GitHub Actions workflow that ran the evals nightly at 03:17 UTC. The evals now run only from a developer machine through `scripts/context-evals/run.mjs`. The PR also notes the unattended run had failed three nights in a row (10-17, 10-18, 10-19) on a single `demo-factory-todo` document.
